title: World of Dwarven Caverns
description: Overhauls the underworld to be much more interesting and viable to explore/inhabit as a skilled Dwarf
body:
Let's be honest, even after the Caves & Cliffs update Minecraft caves are still pretty dull and for a game that's half about mining, that side of it has been very neglected.

Which is where this pack comes in; Minecraft is the perfect game to roleplay as a Dwarf. And to me "It is Dwarven to seek perfection".
So I've added a whole bunch of mods starting with Quality-of-life to make the basic stuff simpler and satisfying. Then of course as I said, the underworld had to be made fun and challenging to explore.
-that includes having a wide range of new areas and mechanics
-new mobs of varying uses and difficulties
-tools and weapons to deal with/optimize the other two

And lastly, there's no point in conquering the underworld if there's nothing to do and no one to share it with once it's all done. In my opinion the homely things like the cooking, decoration, pets and trinkets and instruments are just as important as the guns, backpacks and cogwheels.

There's much more that I've chosen to leave out of the description and a fair bit that you can only experience first-hand, so get out there and start digging, comrade!
